response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates extensive fullstack development experience with a strong focus on TypeScript, React, Node.js, and relational/SQL databases, aligning well with the role's requirements. His leadership in open-source projects, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes), and pragmatic architecture decisions show high technical competence. However, his most recent experience at re:cinq is very brief, and his heavy focus on DLang and AI-agent tooling may not directly match the renewable energy/construction tech stack.
strengths: Deep fullstack expertise with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and SQL/PostgreSQL
Proven experience with scalable architectures, Kubernetes, and AWS services
Strong open-source contributions and leadership in platform development
concerns: Recent role (re:cinq) is very short (April 2025–present), raising questions about stability
Limited direct experience with PostgreSQL, Nest.js, or renewable energy/construction tech
Overqualified for an entry-level role, which may lead to quick turnover or disengagement
